dataset.why: Earth from ETOPO 2022, ESA CCI land cover, the MODIS land surface temperature climatology, WorldClim 2.1 and the Obu permafrost maps; Moon from LOLA LDEM_16, Diviner and LOLA polar illumination (real_data/README.md). Every column has a provenance row with its level.

encoding.column_rule: each column is 'length' values of 'type' starting at byte 'offset' of its file; 'rows' names the row set: land = the Earth cells of earth_base.bin (in id order), passing = the land cells passing the mission (in id order), tile_land = the land cells of one detail tile (in id order, its 'id' column), all = every lunar cell (position = id), grid_rows = one value per grid row (row = floor(id / cols)), grid_cols = one value per grid column (col = id % cols)
encoding.quantised_rule: a column with 'divisor' holds Int32 q; value = q / divisor (divide, do not multiply by scale, to get the exact published value)

detail_tiles.lookup: tile file = detail_tiles.files[k] with row_start <= floor(id / cols) <= row_end; the cell's position in the tile = binary search of id in the tile's 'id' column
